policy.filePriority: Canonical root README; two lexical input/source files whose paths name Unicode/CJK/width/multiline/escaping/invalid regression features; remaining slots round-robin by family/path bucket. .mmd and non-output testdata .txt preferred to static test sources, then docs. Same 13-file cap per project.
policy.issueOrdering: updated descending within state; first 5 issues and first 5 PRs among 30 fetched entries
limitations: Capped convenience sample of development-exposed examples, not usage frequency or a validated holdout.
Issue/PR lists are mutable snapshots: URLs, timestamps, original bodies and hashes retained. The cap may miss older records or one channel when recent activity is skewed.
Only static Mermaid fences, Mermaid-headed text fences and .mmd files are extracted. No interpolation or dynamic program runs.
Source contribution does not change per-project score weight; shared feature strata are reported, not pooled contribution counts.

supplementalSearch.reason: Uniform renderer-topic search supplements monorepo-wide recent activity.

selection.rule: One shortest source per observed family and static feature; then at most eight contributor rounds up to 120 distinct source byte strings, with at most three per family/static-feature/line-count stratum. Ties by source hash. No renderer outcome participates.

excludedSchemas.reason: Documentation syntax schema with placeholder fields, not a concrete executable example
